summary: Screen Time has foreground-app usage per day, daily limits, downtime and a child-restriction state with an observer. Scheduled monitoring through an extension, activity reports and the privacy-preserving report view are missing. iPadOS 15.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: The shell tracks usage and limits; no app-facing schedule or monitor.
Daily limits act as thresholds; no named event API.
No report extension or privacy-preserving report view.
The Screen Time state is readable by apps; no authorization request.
A URL filter exists; it is not tied to activity reporting.

gaps: No extension API to monitor scheduled activity or receive events.
No privacy-preserving report view or report extension.
